newsitem.title: USA: Zebra Tech targets small office market.
newsitem.headline: Zebra Tech targets small office market.

text.p: Zebra Technologies Corp, which supplies bar code labeling systems, said Friday it formed a new division to design, develop, manufacture, and distribute low-cost, desktop bar code printers.

Total revenues from bar coding and automated identification were $2.7 billion in 1995, and are projected to reach $5.6 billion by the year 2000. Much of this growth is being fueled by increased use of low-cost printers in the small- and home-office markets, and for applications such as inventory control, document management, and parcel manifesting.
Zebra said it will begin shipping printers for these markets by October 31, 1996.
